theme.title: Silver and black
theme.subtitle: San Antonio, 1989–2003
theme.recap: David Robinson turned the Spurs around overnight, and Tim Duncan's arrival after a 20-win season started a dynasty.

questions.prompt: How many points did David Robinson score against the Clippers on April 24, 1994?
questions.note: 71, breaking George Gervin's Spurs record of 63.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scoring 71 points (breaking George Gervin's single-game franchise record of 63) against the Los Angeles Clippers

funFacts.text: Robinson's scoring-title chase came down to a direct duel with Shaquille O'Neal.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he became locked in a duel for the NBA scoring title with Shaquille O'Neal

funFacts.text: His outburst surpassed George Gervin's longstanding Spurs single-game points record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: breaking George Gervin's single-game franchise record of 63

funFacts.text: That season, Robinson also averaged double-digit rebounds and more than three blocks per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 10.7 rebounds per game, career-high 4.8 assists per game and 3.3 blocks per game

questions.prompt: With rookie David Robinson in 1989–90, the Spurs improved by how many wins over the year before?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs leaped to a record of 56–26 for a remarkable 35 game improvement

funFacts.text: Robinson won Rookie of the Year unanimously after transforming San Antonio's fortunes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he was unanimously named the NBA Rookie of the Year

funFacts.text: Even as an NBA star, Robinson arrived only after completing his initial Navy service.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Robinson was commissioned in the Naval Reserve and was required to serve only an initial active-duty obligation of two years

funFacts.text: His breakout was immortalized in a Sega game titled David Robinson's Supreme Court.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Sega produced a game featuring him entitled David Robinson's Supreme Court

questions.prompt: How many games did the Spurs win in 1996–97, the season before they drafted Tim Duncan?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finished the season with a 20–62 record

funFacts.text: Robinson injured his back before the season, returned briefly, then broke his foot against Miami.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He finally returned in December, but six games later broke his foot in a home game against the Miami Heat

funFacts.text: That rough season gave San Antonio the draft lottery pick it used on Tim Duncan.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They used that pick to select Tim Duncan out of Wake Forest University

funFacts.text: The Spurs lost Sean Elliott for more than half the season amid their injury crisis.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Sean Elliott, who missed more than half the season

questions.prompt: Tim Duncan nearly had a quadruple-double in the 2003 title clincher. How many blocks did he have?
questions.context: 2003 NBA Finals · Game 6 · vs New Jersey
questions.note: Eight, with 21 points, 20 rebounds and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing with 21 points, 20 rebounds, 10 assists and 8 blocks

funFacts.text: The clincher was David Robinson's final NBA game, and he retired as a champion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Perhaps the lasting memory of the series is David Robinson retiring as a champion.

funFacts.text: San Antonio rallied from a nine-point deficit with a stunning 19–0 run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Spurs trailed at one point 72–63 before going on a 19–0 run

funFacts.text: Duncan and Robinson together grabbed more rebounds than the entire Nets roster.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Duncan and Robinson grabbed 37 rebounds between them, more than the total rebounds of the entire Nets team combined

questions.prompt: In 1999 the Spurs set a record for consecutive playoff wins. How many did they win before the streak ended in the Finals?
questions.note: 12 straight, the longest in NBA history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the end of the Spurs' 12-game playoff winning streak, the longest in NBA history at the time.

funFacts.text: That championship came after a lockout shortened the regular season to 50 games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: was shortened from the usual 82-game schedule to 50 games per team

funFacts.text: The Knicks became the first eighth-seeded team to advance all the way to the NBA Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first team in North American sports history to reach a championship series as an eighth seed

funFacts.text: San Antonio swept both the Lakers and Trail Blazers en route to its first Finals trip.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: recorded back-to-back sweeps in the second round and the conference finals
